_about: Arabic Kashida v1 (trained 5 Oct 2026 from 1 Top-100 ref: r40 3lwan.1, rank 8, Arabic finance podcast; ~/reels/style-train/arabic-kashida). Built FOR ARABIC (RTL): the podcast speaker carries it; captions are 1-3 Arabic words in a heavy white sans (Cairo 800/900, no italics ever), centred on the chest, with ONE kashida-stretched emphasis word per caption (tatweel U+0640 inserted via captions.fixes, never letter-spacing) and the active whole word recoloured pink; red full-screen object cards (one engraving icon over a red gradient page, the spoken words above it) break in on the key money/idea words. Slow picture change (~3.3 s), loud master. Dev-tested only on an English clip: a real Arabic test clip is still needed.

director.style: Arabic Kashida: a calm Arabic podcast clip. The speaker carries it (face on screen ~80%); typography is Arabic-first: heavy white sans, centred on the chest, kashida-stretched emphasis. Red object cards are the only scenes.
director.language: Arabic only. Right-to-left. NEVER italics, never bold-or-size changes inside a word, never letter-spacing (it breaks the joined script). Fonts: Cairo 800/900 for captions; Amiri or Noto Naskh Arabic Bold only for a contrast word. Run a joining check on every caption (لا, ـه, ـة).
director.captions: 1-3 words per caption, at most 20 characters per second. captions.fixes maps ONE emphasis word per caption to its kashida form: insert 2-6 tatweel (U+0640 'ـ') between two JOINING letters only (never after ا د ذ ر ز و ة ى or a final letter), e.g. 'الناحية' -> 'الناحـــية', 'تقترض' -> 'تقتـــرض'. At most one stretched word per caption. Active-word highlight = whole-word colour change (pink).
director.cards: 1 red card per ~8-10 s, 1.2-2 s: a stack scene bg accent with icon (engraving: moneybag / coins / hand / chart / lightbulb) and the spoken words as lead (set 'say' to the plain un-stretched spelling so timing matches). Hard cut in and out.
director.safe_area: RTL platforms mirror the action column to the LEFT: keep text inside x 140-1015 (the engine's safe box is LTR; check by eye).
director.rhythm: Picture changes every ~3.3 s; long calm stretches on the speaker are fine (up to 6 s).
